fato_historico: 1987: A coup d'état in Burkina Faso overthrows and kills then President Thomas Sankara.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to shed old skins today, Scorpio. Just as history reminds us that radical shifts can alter the course of destiny, you may find your own perspective evolving unexpectedly. It is a good time to release what no longer serves your spirit, making room for a fresh, courageous rebirth that aligns with your deepest, most authentic desires.
frase_do_dia: Change is the powerful catalyst that awakens your hidden potential and true strength.
significado_numero: Represents the profound power of transformation and soulful evolution.
conselho: Consider letting go of past burdens to welcome new opportunities with open arms.
